analysis: The only change in docs/reference/configuration.md is documentation. It bumps the 'Last updated' date on line 3 to 2026-10-21 and appends a clarification to the MLX_QUANTIZED_CONSTANT_CACHE row, visible near line 593 of the patch: a bf16 GPT-OSS checkpoint keeps bf16 activations, so the constant cache does not apply to it. The change touches no source code, defaults, environment-variable parsing or LaunchAgent passthrough. It affects no security-relevant controls: the T-041 prefix-cache gating, TTL and disk budget, the TB-011 App Attest worker flags, and the logout, endpoint-resumption and token handling are all untouched. The supplied base text shows the surrounding configuration claims, and none are modified. The patch excerpt is truncated at the MLX_GPTOSS_MXFP4_DECODE_FAST_TAIL row, but the changed ranges are marked complete (only lines 3 and 593), so no further changes are expected. I could not verify the accuracy of the new bf16 claim against libs/mlx-swift ConstantArrayCastCache.swift, since that source was not supplied. That is a documentation-accuracy question with no evident security impact, being a performance cache for numeric constants. I found no new attack surface, no invalidated threat-model assumption, and no threat-model update needed.
